reports.title: SURGERY PARTNERS, INC. ANNOUNCES THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS

desk.headline: Revenue down 0.8% to $815.3m after Idaho Falls sale, in line; guidance dropped as buyout price raised to $25 a share

other.label: Net loss to shareholders (GAAP)
other.change: vs -$22.7m a year ago; -$0.16 a share

results: Revenue slipped 0.8% to $815.3m because the Idaho Falls hospitals were sold mid-September; same-facility revenue grew 6.0%, almost all from higher revenue per case.
Adjusted EBITDA eased to $132.7m from $136.4m, with margin at 16.3% versus 16.6%.
Adjusted EPS rose to $0.16 from $0.13, while the GAAP loss to shareholders was $21.1m (-$0.16 a share) after $22.6m of deal and integration costs.
Operating cash flow improved to $103.5m; the Idaho sale brought in cash that was used to cut long-term debt to $3.0bn from $3.6bn at end-2025.
HealthSpan Partners raised its takeover offer to $25.00 a share in cash (enterprise value up to about $6.0bn) after a rival unsolicited bid; closing is still expected in Q1 2027.

guidance.summary: Surgery Partners will no longer give forward guidance while the HealthSpan Partners takeover is pending, as is usual during a sale.

call.source: No call held — the company skipped its earnings call because of the pending merger

watch: Shareholder vote and regulatory approvals for the $25-a-share HealthSpan deal, targeted for Q1 2027.
Any further move from the unnamed rival bidder.
Monthly cash 'ticking fee' at 10% a year if the deal is approved but not closed by 1 March 2027.
